name: Ooshiro Fumika
source:
She takes care of her daughter's new childhood friend in many ways. She is a widow who unknowingly continues to emit erotic pheromones.

She is a high school teacher by profession, and the protagonist and her daughter are students at the same high school.

[From [url=http://kikenn.sakura.ne.jp/KuroyokamI/topindexPL0002.htm]official site[/url]]
